objective: Tighten the repo harness so an agent can run substantial changes without repeated manual clarification.
success_criteria: A machine-readable task contract schema, validator, and example exist.
The stable command surface includes task-contract and audit entrypoints.
Harness checks emit remediation guidance instead of bare failures.
All required repo-local validation commands pass.
stop_conditions: The requested work conflicts with AGENTS.md failure-ledger rules.
The task requires deleting user-authored files or changing v1 scope.
A failing check cannot be resolved without introducing a new policy decision.
notes: Use docs/app-design-spec.md as the canonical design source.
Keep meetings separate from final tasks and preserve the review gate.
